site: Workday (Invesco, Altera Digital Health; cross-portal salary & sponsorship-qualified radio/select inputs)
class: Compensation questions phrased as expected earnings or desired annual compensation missed DESIRED_SALARY and fell through to open-ended AI paragraphs, while sponsorship-qualified Yes choices on radio groups and native selects bypassed sponsorship_choice
symptom: On Invesco Step 3 ('What would you expect to earn per year in the position for which you have applied? Please provide a numerical value.*'), match_concept returned None and the AI typed a 45-word paragraph instead of '125000'. On Altera Digital Health ('What is your desired annual compensation?*'), match_concept also returned None. Additionally, radio groups, cached native_select recipes, and _choose_inside called _best_option directly without option_match.sponsorship_choice.
root_cause: DESIRED_SALARY patterns only matched 'desired salary/pay/compensation' without intervening words like 'annual'/'base' and had no pattern for 'expect to earn' or 'expected annual earnings'; DESIRED_SALARY also formatted a '$min - $max' range even when the prompt explicitly requested a numerical value. For option selection, f184 wired sponsorship_choice into PageAgent._pick but left _control_for, cached native_select, radio/checkbox groups in do(), and _choose_inside calling _best_option directly.
why_tests_missed: Existing salary tests used 'Desired Salary' or pay-band dropdowns rather than 'expect to earn ... numerical value' or 'desired annual compensation', and f184 unit tests called PageAgent._pick directly rather than _control_for or radio/select paths.
fix: Add expected-earnings and desired-annual/base-compensation patterns to DESIRED_SALARY in reference/concepts.json; return plain numeric str(int(float(minimum))) in concept_matcher.resolve_profile_value when the question requests a numerical value; and route _control_for, cached native_select, radio/checkbox group selection, and _choose_inside through PageAgent._sponsorship_option / _match_option.
prevention: Scan all saved production snapshots when expanding concept patterns, format numeric-only salary prompts as plain numbers, and route all option-picking paths through shared profile-aware helpers.
